purpose: Edit a bounded complete one-time code in one native input with paste, autocomplete and native form participation.
anatomy: one native text or password input
behaviorProvider: Native input through Aegis TextInput; wrapper candidate normalization.

component: Render one real native input with autocomplete one-time-code, numeric or text inputMode, length constraints and one optional form name. Do not create separate character cells with fabricated accessibility semantics.

Numeric mode keeps ASCII digits; alphanumeric mode uppercases ASCII letters and keeps ASCII digits. Paste normalizes the full clipboard text before length truncation and replaces the current selection through an ordinary native input event.
Require an integer length from 1 through 32. Empty is an empty string; leading zeroes are retained. Apply normalization to initial, controlled and edited candidates.
Call onComplete for a changed candidate whose normalized length is complete. It does not submit a form, authenticate a person, verify a code or mark a code consumed.
Preserve native TextInput ref, name/form, change callbacks, readOnly/disabled, required and Field association. masked changes only text visibility.
host: Own code verification, expiry, retry limits, resend flow, authentication, secure handling and error feedback. Treat one-time-code as an autofill hint whose actual support depends on browser/platform.

Owned styling consumes input group tokens. Actual nested shared components retain their own token groups. Preserve keyboard-visible focus and equivalent size metrics across the four theme/mode mappings.

limitations: This source-backed requirement record does not certify a current test result or release approval.
ASCII numeric/alphanumeric codes only; localized numerals and arbitrary Unicode code alphabets are not supported.
No operating-system SMS retrieval, automatic submission, authentication or code security policy.
